data.title: Grandmaster Praggnanandhaa Tops Elite Field to Claim First Rapid & Blitz Title at 2026 Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz
data.description: In St. Louis, GM Praggnanandhaa emerged victorious at the 2026 Saint Louis Rapid & Blitz tournament, marking his first Rapid & Blitz title win. Held by the Saint Louis Chess Club as the inaugural U.S. Grand Chess Tour (GCT) event, the Indian grandmaster secured the victory by leading in the rapid section with an impressive 12 points out of 18. He clinched the overall title during the blitz section, earning a prize of $50,000. Furthermore, his stellar performance in the rapid matches propelled him into the top 10 of the world rapid rankings for the first time.

data.description: A government report reveals that the unemployment rate in the country has risen to 8.5%, a significant increase from the previous quarter. The report shows that over 2 million people are currently out of work. Additionally, the number of job vacancies has decreased by 15% compared to the same period last year. The manufacturing sector has been hit the hardest, with a 20% decrease in employment opportunities. The report also highlights a rise in underemployment, with 1.5 million individuals working part-time unable to secure full-time employment. Experts warn that the economic recovery may be slow, and government intervention is necessary to address the ongoing job crisis.

data.title: Visible Gold Announces Stock Option Grant
data.description: ROUYN-NORANDA, Québec – Visible Gold Mines Inc. (TSXV: VGD) (FRANKFURT: 3V41) has disclosed that its Board of Directors approved the issuance of stock options for a total of 850,000 common shares, with 800,000 allocated to directors and 50,000 to consultants. The options are subject to regulatory approval, including from the TSX Venture Exchange. These stock options are accessible at a specified price, in accordance with the Company's stock option plan.

data.title: Cencosud advances its multiformat omnichannel ecosystem strategy, reaching a record 31 million active loyalty customers
data.description: In Santiago, Chile, Cencosud released its Q2 2026 results, showcasing progress in its multiformat omnichannel ecosystem strategy. The company experienced a significant upsurge in online sales, registering double-digit growth. Additionally, it further solidified its loyalty programs, achieving a milestone of 31 million active loyalty customers throughout the region. Cencosud also expanded its private-label range and pursued strategic acquisitions in Brazil and Colombia during the quarter.
